title: 🎮 Weekends (выходные) & Present Simple vs Present Continuous
description: Учимся говорить о том, что мы делаем обычно и что делаем прямо сейчас. Мемы, игры и выходные с пользой! 🎮

days.title: Day 1: Weekend Activities
days.description: Что мы делаем на выходных? Учим слова и фразы

grammar.title: Weekend Activities — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Что мы делаем на выходных?**

🏠 **stay at home** — оставаться дома
🛍️ **go shopping** — ходить за покупками
🎬 **watch a film** — смотреть фильм
🎮 **play video games** — играть в видеоигры
📚 **read a book** — читать книгу
🚴 **ride a bike** — кататься на велосипеде
🏊 **go swimming** — ходить плавать
🎂 **meet friends** — встречаться с друзьями

🎯 **Мем**:
'What do you do at the weekend?'
'I sleep. That's my plan.' 😴

vocabulary.example: On rainy days, I stay at home.
vocabulary.context_example: В дождливые дни я остаюсь дома.

vocabulary.example: Mum and I go shopping on Saturdays.
vocabulary.context_example: Мы с мамой ходим за покупками по субботам.

vocabulary.example: We watch a film on Sunday evenings.
vocabulary.context_example: Мы смотрим фильм по воскресеньям вечером.

vocabulary.example: I play video games with my friends.
vocabulary.context_example: Я играю в видеоигры с друзьями.

vocabulary.example: I read a book before bed.
I ride my bike in the park.
vocabulary.context_example: Я катаюсь на велосипеде в парке.

vocabulary.example: We go swimming every Sunday.
I meet my friends at the weekend.
vocabulary.context_example: Я встречаюсь с друзьями на выходных.

exercises.question: What do you do when it's rainy? ☔
exercises.explanation: When it's rainy, many people STAY AT HOME! 🏠

exercises.question: I ___ shopping with my mum. (go / stay)
exercises.explanation: Go shopping — ходить за покупками! 🛍️

exercises.question: You ride a bike with your friends. 🚴
exercises.explanation: Yes! You ride a bike with friends! 🚴

exercises.question: I ___ friends at the weekend. (meet / read)
exercises.explanation: Meet friends — встречаться с друзьями! 🎂

exercises.question: I go swim every Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Go SWIMMING — нужно -ing! 🏊

days.title: Day 2: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
days.description: Учимся различать обычные действия и действия сейчас

grammar.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
grammar.rule:
📘 **Когда использовать каждое время**:

📌 **Present Simple** — для обычных, повторяющихся действий:
✅ I usually play football on Saturdays.
✅ She always reads before bed.

📌 **Present Continuous** — для действий, происходящих прямо сейчас:
✅ I am playing football right now.
✅ She is reading a book at the moment.

🎯 **Ключевые слова**:
• Present Simple: usually, always, sometimes, never, often, every day
• Present Continuous: now, right now, at the moment

🎯 **Мем**:
'I usually do homework. But right now I am scrolling TikTok.' 📱

vocabulary.example: I usually get up at 8 am.
I am doing homework now.
I always brush my teeth.
I never wake up late on weekdays.
vocabulary.context_example: Я никогда не просыпаюсь поздно по будням.

vocabulary.example: I study English every day.
I sometimes cook breakfast.

exercises.question: What do you usually do at the weekend? 🎮
exercises.explanation: Usually = Present Simple! 🎮

exercises.question: Right now, I ___ (watch) TV. 📺
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! 📺

exercises.question: 'I am watching TV' means it's a habit.
exercises.explanation: Am watching = action happening NOW, not a habit! 📺

exercises.question: I ___ (usually / play) football on Saturdays. ⚽
exercises.explanation: Usually = Present Simple! I usually play! ⚽

exercises.question: I am usually play video games.
exercises.explanation: Usually = Present Simple! Без am! 🎮

days.title: Day 3: What is Everyone Doing Now?
days.description: Учимся описывать, что делают люди в данный момент

grammar.title: Present Continuous — описание действий сейчас
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как описать, что происходит сейчас**:

📌 **Структура**:
✅ [to be] + [глагол + -ing]

📝 **Примеры**:
✅ Mum is cooking dinner.
✅ Dad is reading a book.
✅ My sister is playing with her toys.
✅ I am doing my homework.

🎯 **Вопросы**:
❓ What is Mum doing? — She is cooking.
❓ Are you doing your homework? — Yes, I am.

🎯 **Мем**:
'What are you doing?'
'I am pretending to do homework. But actually I'm on TikTok.' 😅

vocabulary.example: Mum is cooking dinner right now.
Dad is reading a newspaper.
My sister is playing with her toys.
I am doing my homework.
The boys are playing games.
The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

exercises.question: What is Mum doing? 🍳
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! She is cooking! 👩‍🍳

exercises.question: The cat ___ (sleep) on the sofa. 🐱
exercises.explanation: The cat is sleeping — кот спит прямо сейчас! 🐱💤

exercises.question: 'I am doing homework' means I do homework every day.
exercises.explanation: I am doing = ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС, а не каждый день! 📚

exercises.question: Dad ___ (read) a newspaper. 📰
exercises.explanation: Dad is reading — папа читает прямо сейчас! 📰

exercises.question: The boys are play games.
exercises.explanation: Нужно playING! Present Continuous! 🎮

days.title: Day 4: Reading — A Typical Weekend
days.description: Читаем текст о том, что люди делают на выходных

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Обрати внимание: что делают ОБЫЧНО (Present Simple), а что ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС (Present Continuous).
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Смотри на ключевые слова!

exercises.question: What is the family doing right now? 🎬
exercises.explanation: The family is watching a film together right now! 🎬
exercises.readingText:
🌟 A TYPICAL WEEKEND WITH THE JOHNSON FAMILY 🌟

It's Saturday morning. Everyone is doing their own thing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕘 9 AM — SATURDAY MORNING

Mum is in the living room. She is drinking coffee and reading a magazine. She usually reads magazines on Saturday mornings. ☕

Dad is in the garden. He is planting flowers. He always plants flowers in spring. 🌷

Leo is in his room. He is playing video games. He usually plays video games on Saturday mornings. 🎮

Mia is in her room too. She is drawing. She often draws pictures of animals. 🎨

Luna the cat is sleeping on Leo's bed. She always sleeps there. 🐱

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕒 3 PM — SATURDAY AFTERNOON

Now the family is together! They are having a picnic in the park. It's a beautiful sunny day. 🌞

Mum is making sandwiches. Dad is playing football with Leo and Mia. They are having fun!

Luna is not with them. She is at home, sleeping as usual. 🐱💤

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕗 8 PM — SATURDAY EVENING

The family is back home. They are watching a film together. It's a comedy. Everyone is laughing. 🎬

Mum is eating popcorn. Dad is drinking tea. Leo and Mia are fighting over the remote control.

'Give me the remote!' Leo says.

'No! It's my turn!' Mia says.

This is a typical Saturday evening in the Johnson house. 😅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 WHAT ABOUT YOU?
What do you usually do on weekends? What are you doing right now? 👇

exercises.question: What does Mum usually do on Saturday mornings? ☕
exercises.explanation: Mum usually reads magazines on Saturday mornings! ☕

exercises.question: The family is having a picnic on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: They are having a picnic on SATURDAY afternoon! 🌞

exercises.question: Leo and Mia are fighting over the remote control.
exercises.explanation: Yes! 'Leo and Mia are fighting over the remote control.' 😅

exercises.question: The family is watching a ___ . 🎬
exercises.explanation: They are watching a film! 🎬

days.title: Day 5: Present Simple vs Present Continuous Practice

grammar.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — практика
grammar.rule:
📘 **Когда какое время использовать**:

📌 **Present Simple** (обычные действия):
✅ I always read before bed.
✅ She usually goes to school by bus.

📌 **Present Continuous** (прямо сейчас):
✅ I am reading a book right now.
✅ She is going to school at the moment.

🎯 **Ключевые слова-помощники**:
• always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day → Present Simple
• now, right now, at the moment → Present Continuous

exercises.question: I ___ to music every day. 🎵
exercises.explanation: Every day = Present Simple! I listen! 🎵

exercises.question: Right now, I ___ (listen) to music. 🎧
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! I am listening! 🎧

exercises.question: 'She is usually sleeping' is correct.
exercises.explanation: Usually = Present Simple! 'She usually sleeps'! 😴

exercises.question: They ___ (watch) a film right now. 🎬
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! They are watching! 🎬

exercises.question: He is always play football on Sundays.
exercises.correct: He always plays football on Sundays.
accept: He always plays football on Sundays
He always plays football on Sundays.
exercises.explanation: Always = Present Simple! He plays, not is playing! ⚽

days.title: Day 6: Writing — What I Do on Weekends

grammar.title: Повторение: выходные и два времени
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ Что ты обычно делаешь на выходных? (Present Simple)
2️⃣ Что ты делаешь прямо сейчас? (Present Continuous)
3️⃣ Используй слова-помощники: usually, sometimes, now, right now
4️⃣ Добавь детали: с кем, где, почему

🎯 **Пример**:
I usually wake up late on weekends. I often play video games with my friends. But right now, I am doing my homework. I am not having fun! 😅

exercises.question: I usually ___ (wake up / sleep) late on weekends.
exercises.explanation: Usually = Present Simple! I wake up late! 😴

exercises.question: I often play video games with my ___ . (напиши с кем)
exercises.explanation: С кем ты играешь в игры? 🎮

exercises.question: Right now, I ___ (write) my homework.
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! I am writing! ✍️

exercises.question: I am not having ___ . (fun / homework)
exercises.explanation: Не весело, когда делаешь уроки! 😅

exercises.question: I like weekends because I can ___ . (напиши что-то своё)
exercises.explanation: За что ты любишь выходные? 💖
